messages:
Alex W: Quick pre-holiday snapshot — can we run the weekly capacity check now? seeing some weird smoothing needs across regions.
Priya S: +1, I pulled the burn numbers for the last 72h. overall fleet ~4200 GPU-hours/day baseline, forecast +12-18% next 10 days depending on marketing promo and PLG signups.
Mateo R: FYI ap-southeast has a higher spot eviction rate this week (avg 7% -> 14%). linked to maintenance windows in provider AZs. that cluster's effective capacity drops ~9% during evictions.
Jenn L: Noted. is that contributing to the latency blips we saw yesterday? ticket INC-2345 had node attach failures in apac.
Mateo R: yeah, INC-2345 — networking flap on host-level vNICs during rolling maintenance. throughput degraded ~18% for short bursts, recovered after NIC rebind.
Alex W: Ok, high-level numbers I put together:
- us-west: baseline 2100 GPU-hrs/day, forecast 2400 (+14%), buffer target 10% -> want to reserve +240 GPU-hrs/day
- eu-central: baseline 1200, forecast 1380 (+15%), buffer target 12% -> reserve +166 GPU-hrs/day
- ap-southeast: baseline 900, forecast 1050 (+17%), effective capacity hit by spot -> we need fallback plan
Priya S: Suggestion: shift 20% of flexible inference traffic from ap-southeast -> eu-central during peak hours to avoid spot churn. we can use smart-routing policy alpha for cost-aware reroute.
Mateo R: That works but watch network egress between regions. cross-region traffic adds ~6-9ms and ~0.3% added cost; not huge but call it out.
Jenn L: Ops ask: can we pre-warm 8 reserved GPUs in ap-southeast for the holiday window? that removes spot risk but costs ~+$4k/week.
Alex W: Cost tradeoff: pre-warm cost vs failed requests and retries. if expected ramp is sustained, pre-warm looks justified. propose: 8 reserved in apac for next 10 days, monitor utilization hourly.
Priya S: Also propose autoscaler tweak: reduce max_batch_latency from 50ms -> 40ms during high load windows to improve tail latency; small throughput hit but better SLO adherence.
Mateo R: I'll add a canary rule to the autoscaler: only apply reduced latency threshold when queue depth > 20 and avg token/sec > X. avoid flapping.
ops-bot: Deploy-triggered: routing-policy update alpha scheduled at 2024-12-18T02:00Z by Mateo R — tracked in RFC-ops-319.
Jenn L: Action items:
1) Mateo to open reservation for 8 gpus in ap-southeast (order ETA 3h) — if order delayed, failover to eu-central shift.
2) Priya to apply forecast tags and run cost sims (best/worst/mid) by EOD.
3) Alex to publish updated per-route SLO targets and notify support on expected ticketing increase.
Alex W: Timelines: implement routing tweak in 2h, reserve request now, autoscaler canary tomorrow morning. Share back metrics at 6h and 24h.
Priya S: I'll run the cost sims with spot vs reserved delta and post a short table in this thread.
Mateo R: I'll also instrument the apac NIC repro and add a quick grafana panel for NIC rebind events per host — will post link when ready.
Jenn L: If we see >20% eviction in apac, we trigger emergency reroute to dedicated capacity in us-west until reservations come up.
Alex W: Good. last ask — anyone see capacity shortages in any smaller internal clusters (dev/test) that we can reduce during the window? we should free up any noncritical pools.
Priya S: dev-nano and ci-runner pools are low priority — can scale them to 0.5x for 72h. I'll submit the change.
ops-bot: Reminder: weekly-capacity-summary posted to #eng-infra at 18:00 UTC.
Alex W: Thanks everyone — let's reconvene in 6h if anything spikes. :thumbsup:
